comments:
Possibly the work mentioned by A khu ching, [5RXEUKD9]: 531, No. 11557: 'od zer mgon po'i phar phyin.

Contains over a hundred references to the views of other scholars, who are however not named in the main text, and are not identified in glosses in instance (ID:4579).

Includes a discussion on the two truths.
Uses formalized inferential arguments.
Mention of categories of the seven-fold typology of mental events.
